11.0.old:
- THE GEMINI DEBATER RUNS GEMINI 4 HYDROGEN (ASK 487; model_config row gemini_deb, Init Seats ENG):
    - Why: the operator chose option A on the gemini card: "point gemini (debater) at a non-flash model".
    - What it does: one model_config row, gemini_deb (provider openrouter, role engine, `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`, OpenRouter endpoint, max_tokens 64000 per the standing "set all to 64k", family google, active), written before the code; Init Seats ENG gemini reads mc `gemini_deb` instead of `gemini`. The debater named "gemini" now runs `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`; judge seat gemini stays `google/gemini-3.8-flash`, and seat hydrogen is unchanged. gemini_deb is in no seat list; it is read only as the gemini debater's mc_seat. Family stays google, so the debater-family exclusions are unchanged.
    - The fault ledger (model_config_jfl) is keyed by model, so gemini_deb shows hydrogen's jfl_counts, jfl_move and jfl_block; none of them reaches a debater (jfl_block enters prompts only through `__JFL` in Panel Build, Reserve Build and the alternate builds, looked up by judge seat).
    - Cost: the gemini debater's price per million tokens goes from 0.75 in / 3.75 out to 1.50 / 7.50 USD (Vercel AI Gateway list price). Stored rows name the engine gemini with model `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`.
    - Limits: shown by the next run with gemini as a debater.

    - Stored rows of runs made under ASK 487 name the engine gemini with model `google/gemini-4-hydrogen`.
